title: Tissue Glycogen Analysis Protocol
author: John Stack
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y39fyr6

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize approximately 25mg of tissue samples using 0.6N perchloric acid (PCA).

substeps.instruction: Keep samples in liquid nitrogen until ready to weigh.
Record the weight of the tissue.
Add an amount of 0.6N PCA to labeled 12x75mm plastic shaker tubes equal to 5 times the tissue weight; keep tubes on ice.
Add tissue to plastic homogenizing tubes and homogenize in a shaker at 20Hz for 30 seconds.
Retain the PCA homogenized mixture until results are calculated.

steps.title: Perform Glycogen Hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Digest the PCA homogenate using amyloglucosidase to release glucose.

substeps.instruction: Add 50µL of PCA homogenate to labeled microfuge tubes.
Prepare a fresh amyloglucosidase solution with a ratio of 2mg enzyme per 1mL acetate buffer.
Pipette 125µL of the fresh amyloglucosidase solution into each microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Analyze Glycogen Content
steps.instruction: Measure the glucose concentration in the digested samples using the Cobas Mira Glucose method.

steps.title: Calculate Glycogen Concentration
steps.instruction: Calculate the glycogen content expressed as the gm % glycogen in tissue (weight percentage of liver).

description: Background (free glucose in tissue homogenate) 10) While glycogen samples are incubating, centrifuge tubes containing PCA homogenate for 1 minute at 10,000 rpm. 11) Measure the glucose concentration of the PCA homogenate solution (Cobas Mira Glucose method) to obtain the amount of free glucose in each sample.
